title: Coffin of Argentina
description: A man in a black suit with a red and black armband stands behind a wooden coffin draped with the flag of Argentina, which is engulfed in blue flames. To the right, a massive demonic beast with fiery orange and yellow flames, sharp teeth and claws emerges from smoke, facing the man inside a dilapidated, peeling blue and pink room with dramatic light rays from above.
prompt: A surreal cinematic scene inside a decaying abandoned room with peeling blue and pink walls. A man in a black suit and red black armband stands solemnly behind a wooden coffin covered with the Argentine flag, the coffin burning with bright blue flames. To the right, a giant monstrous demonic beast made of fire and smoke with a wolf-like head, sharp teeth and claws, crouches aggressively. Dramatic god rays shine from a hole in the ceiling, scattered white flowers and a broken camera on the dirty floor, dark moody atmosphere.
